Check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00; late check-out to 14:00 subject to availability. Cancellations are free up to 48h before arrival, one night’s rate after. Groups of 10+ rooms get a dedicated coordinator and a 10% rate; the event spaces seat 120 banquet-style or 200 standing. Weddings run three packages — Intimate, Classic, Grand — covering the ballroom or the waterfront terrace, in-house catering from Vela’s kitchen, and a preferred-vendor list for florists and photographers; quote a package, never a firm price, without confirming the date with the events team.
